title: Script History grows without bound for the whole session
body:
## Summary
useBlenderStore keeps every dispatched job and its full output string forever; nothing caps or evicts.

## Description
src/components/modules/visual-gen/blender-pipeline/useBlenderStore.ts addScript prepends a job on every executeViaMCP call (src/components/modules/visual-gen/blender-pipeline/ScriptRunner.tsx executeViaMCP), and 8 non-test modules dispatch through it (procedural exports, scene composer, LOD, mesh stats, auto-rig...). Each job stores the script's printed output, and ScriptRunner renders every row. Only "Clear finished" trims it, by hand. A long session accumulates hundreds of rows and their outputs in memory and in the DOM. Fixed looks like: a retention cap (e.g. newest 100) applied in addScript, with the panel saying how many older rows were dropped so the record stays honest.

## Flow
- dispatch N scripts in one session (procedural export loop, repeated Mesh Stats reads)
- useBlenderStore.scripts.length === N, every output retained
- ScriptRunner renders N ScriptCards, each with a 1 s interval while running

## Expected impact
Operators running long sessions keep a bounded panel and heap; measured as retained rows after 500 dispatches. Could break: a user relying on scrolling back past the cap.

## Evaluation
Claim: performance - bounded memory/DOM for the Script History
Before: 500 dispatches -> 500 retained jobs (by reading addScript: no cap)
After: predicted: 500 dispatches -> <= cap retained, dropped count shown
Method: simulation - read of addScript; no harness run, the cap value is a product choice
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
src/components/modules/visual-gen/blender-pipeline/useBlenderStore.ts addScript: set((s) => ({ scripts: [job, ...s.scripts] })) - no length bound
grep -rln "blender-pipeline/ScriptRunner'" src (non-test) -> 8 dispatching modules
impact: Operators running long sessions keep a bounded panel and heap; measured as retained rows after 500 dispatches. Could break: a user relying on scrolling back past the cap.
instrument: vitest: call addScript 500x, assert scripts.length <= CAP and a droppedCount field; render ScriptRunner and count ScriptCards

title: Asset Browser category chip changes the filter without re-running the search
body:
## Summary
Clicking a PolyHaven category chip marks it active but the grid keeps the previous results; Sketchfab results never honour the category at all.

## Description
src/components/modules/visual-gen/blender-pipeline/useAssetBrowser.ts:75-102 reads category only inside search(), which runs on the Search submit (src/components/modules/visual-gen/blender-pipeline/AssetBrowser.tsx form onSubmit). The chips (src/components/modules/visual-gen/blender-pipeline/AssetBrowser.tsx Chip, aria-pressed) only call setCategory. So after a search, pressing "models" shows aria-pressed=true over results that were fetched for "All". The Sketchfab half (sketch URLSearchParams) never receives category, so even after re-searching, an active PolyHaven chip sits over unfiltered Sketchfab rows. Fixed looks like: a chip change re-runs search when a search has already happened, and Sketchfab rows are labelled as unaffected by the PolyHaven facet (or hidden while a facet is active).

## Flow
- connect, search "rock"
- click the "textures" chip -> chip pressed, grid unchanged, no fetch
- results shown do not match the pressed filter

## Expected impact
Operators browsing by category see results that match the active chip. Could break: an extra search request per chip click.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - visible filter state matches the shown results
Before: after a search, 1 chip click -> 0 fetches, 0 of N rows re-filtered (read of useAssetBrowser.search deps)
After: predicted: 1 chip click -> 1 polyhaven fetch with category, Sketchfab rows marked
Method: simulation - traced the two call paths; the existing AssetBrowser.test.tsx does not cover chip clicks
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
src/components/modules/visual-gen/blender-pipeline/useAssetBrowser.ts:84 if (category) poly.set('category', category);  (only polyhaven)
src/components/modules/visual-gen/blender-pipeline/useAssetBrowser.ts:85-86 sketch params: source + query only
src/components/modules/visual-gen/blender-pipeline/AssetBrowser.tsx Chip onClick={() => b.setCategory(...)} - no search()
impact: Operators browsing by category see results that match the active chip. Could break: an extra search request per chip click.
instrument: component test in src/__tests__/components/blender-mcp/AssetBrowser.test.tsx: search, click a chip, count fetches and assert the polyhaven URL carries category

title: Migrate the 7 residual raw /api/blender-mcp/execute dispatches to executeViaMCP
body:
## Summary
Seven modules outside this context still fetch the execute route directly, so their scripts never appear in Script History.

## Description
src/__tests__/lib/blender-mcp/execute-dispatch-guard.test.ts UNMIGRATED lists 7 files (material-lab/useMaterialStore.ts, materials/PostProcessStackBuilder, materials/MaterialPatternCatalog, level-design/ProceduralLevelWizard, level-design/LevelFlowEditor, animations/shared/state-machine-shared.ts, animations/AIComboChoreographer). The panel src/components/modules/visual-gen/blender-pipeline/ScriptRunner.tsx presents itself as the record of what PoF dispatched, and is missing these. Each migration is mechanical (replace tryApiFetch(ROUTE) with executeViaMCP(name, code), delete the guard line). Out of scope for this context: each file belongs to another context.

## Flow
- send a material from Material Lab
- Script History shows no row for it
- per site: swap to executeViaMCP, delete its UNMIGRATED entry, guard stays green

## Expected impact
Script History becomes complete; measured by the guard's UNMIGRATED length. Could break: a site that relied on the raw reply shape (executeViaMCP returns the same Result).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - every dispatch recorded
Before: UNMIGRATED = 7 entries (guard test)
After: UNMIGRATED = 0, guard green
Method: probe - counted the guard list; the guard itself is the gate
Result: better
Gate: none
impact: Script History becomes complete; measured by the guard's UNMIGRATED length. Could break: a site that relied on the raw reply shape (executeViaMCP returns the same Result).
instrument: execute-dispatch-guard.test.ts (already enforces shrink-only) plus each migrated module's existing tests

title: Status tones in the Blender pipeline bypass status-tokens (8 raw classes, 2 greens)
body:
## Summary
LodPlanTable, ScriptRunner, AssetBrowser and AssetCard hand-roll text-green/amber/red/emerald-400 instead of the status-tokens module, and ScriptRunner's "done" green drifts to emerald.

## Description
src/lib/blender-mcp/status-tokens.ts declares itself the single source for Blender MCP status colour but exports only WARNING_TEXT for text tone. So src/components/modules/visual-gen/blender-pipeline/BlenderPipelineView/LodPlanTable.tsx:13-15 (OK/WARN/BAD), src/components/modules/visual-gen/blender-pipeline/ScriptRunner.tsx:13-14,59 (emerald-400, red-400) and src/components/modules/visual-gen/blender-pipeline/AssetBrowser.tsx:141 (amber-400, while the same file uses WARNING_TEXT at its connect hint) and src/components/modules/visual-gen/blender-pipeline/AssetCard.tsx:101 carry raw classes. ScriptRunner uses emerald-400 for success where every other Blender surface uses green-400. Fixed: add SUCCESS_TEXT / ERROR_TEXT to status-tokens.ts (blender-mcp-bridge context) and adopt them at the 8 sites.

## Flow
- add SUCCESS_TEXT/ERROR_TEXT to src/lib/blender-mcp/status-tokens.ts
- replace the 8 raw tone classes in this context
- emerald -> green in ScriptRunner

## Expected impact
One theme edit recolours every Blender status; the emerald/green drift disappears. Could break: nothing functional (class strings).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one source for status tone
Before: 8 raw status-tone classes in 4 files, 2 distinct success greens
After: 0 raw, 1 green
Method: probe - grep count over the context; needs a sibling-owned token file so not built here
Result: better
Gate: none
impact: One theme edit recolours every Blender status; the emerald/green drift disappears. Could break: nothing functional (class strings).
instrument: the same grep as a source-scanning test (comments stripped) over src/components/modules/visual-gen/blender-pipeline

title: Mesh Optimization has no measured-mesh picker, unlike the LOD tab
body:
## Summary
The LOD tab lets the operator read scene meshes and pick one; Mesh Optimization still asks for a free-typed object name.

## Description
src/components/modules/visual-gen/blender-pipeline/BlenderPipelineView/LODGenerationTab.tsx uses useMeshStats (one explicit read, recorded in Script History) and a "Measured meshes" select, so a typo cannot dispatch against a missing object. src/components/modules/visual-gen/blender-pipeline/BlenderPipelineView/MeshOptimizationTab.tsx only has MCPTextInput for the object name; a misspelt name dispatches and comes back as a Python ValueError. Fixed: reuse useMeshStats + the same select in MeshOptimizationTab (both in this context).

## Flow
- type "SM_Rok" in Mesh Optimization
- dispatch -> optimize-mesh raises "not found or not a mesh"
- with a picker the operator selects SM_Rock from the measured list

## Expected impact
Fewer failed dispatches from typos; parity between the two mesh tabs. Could break: nothing - free text stays.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - pick a real mesh instead of typing
Before: 0 of 1 mesh-picker case in MeshOptimizationTab (LOD: 1 of 1)
After: 1 of 1
Method: simulation - read both tabs; not built this round (budget), a component test decides it
Result: better
Gate: none
impact: Fewer failed dispatches from typos; parity between the two mesh tabs. Could break: nothing - free text stays.
instrument: component test: click Read scene meshes in MeshOptimizationTab with a mocked mesh-stats receipt, assert a Measured meshes combobox fills the object name

title: Move executeViaMCP out of the ScriptRunner UI component into lib
body:
## Summary
The one Blender dispatcher is exported from a React component file, so 8 non-UI modules import a component (and lucide) to send a script.

## Description
src/components/modules/visual-gen/blender-pipeline/ScriptRunner.tsx exports executeViaMCP alongside the ScriptRunner component; src/components/modules/visual-gen/blender-pipeline/BlenderPipelineView/useScriptExecution.ts, useMeshStats.ts and 6 modules in other contexts import it from there. A dispatcher belongs in src/lib/blender-mcp (e.g. dispatch.ts) with the store dependency injected or imported; ScriptRunner.tsx re-exports for compatibility. execute-dispatch-guard.test.ts WRAPPER must move with it.

## Flow
- create src/lib/blender-mcp/dispatch.ts with executeViaMCP
- re-export from ScriptRunner.tsx
- update WRAPPER in execute-dispatch-guard.test.ts
- migrate importers

## Expected impact
Non-UI modules stop depending on a component module. Could break: the guard if WRAPPER is not updated.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - dispatcher not coupled to a UI file
Before: 8 non-test modules import executeViaMCP from a .tsx component
After: 0 (lib import), guard green
Method: probe - grep count of importers; crosses sibling contexts so not built
Result: better
Gate: none
impact: Non-UI modules stop depending on a component module. Could break: the guard if WRAPPER is not updated.
instrument: importer grep as a test plus execute-dispatch-guard.test.ts and the touched modules' tests

title: Asset import keeps every Import button disabled through the viewport snapshot
body:
## Summary
After a successful download, importingKey stays set until the best-effort viewport screenshot returns, blocking all other imports for that round trip.

## Description
src/components/modules/visual-gen/blender-pipeline/useAssetBrowser.ts:126-138: on result.ok the hook awaits captureViewportSnapshot() before setImportingKey(null); src/components/modules/visual-gen/blender-pipeline/AssetBrowser.tsx passes disabled={... || b.importingKey !== null} to every card. The snapshot is documented as best-effort ("a snapshot failure never masks a successful import") yet it gates the next import. Fixed: clear importingKey once the import is confirmed, then capture.

## Flow
- import asset A (succeeds)
- screenshot request still pending (slow viewport)
- every other card Import button disabled until it returns

## Expected impact
Faster back-to-back imports. Could break: two imports could overlap the snapshot (it captures whatever is in the viewport - harmless).

## Evaluation
Claim: user - import availability after a confirmed import
Before: cards disabled for the full screenshot round trip (read of useAssetBrowser.ts:133-138)
After: predicted: enabled immediately after the download confirms
Method: simulation - traced the await order; a test with a pending screenshot fetch decides it
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence:
src/components/modules/visual-gen/blender-pipeline/useAssetBrowser.ts:133 const shot = await captureViewportSnapshot();
src/components/modules/visual-gen/blender-pipeline/useAssetBrowser.ts:138 setImportingKey(null);  (after the snapshot)
impact: Faster back-to-back imports. Could break: two imports could overlap the snapshot (it captures whatever is in the viewport - harmless).
instrument: component test: mock download ok + never-resolving screenshot fetch, assert a second card Import is enabled
